rationale: Price is sitting exactly at today's high with zero distance remaining, meaning the stock is at the top of its intraday range after a large gap-up (~9.4% from prior close) and a strong intraday run from $9.27 to $10.01. Entering long at the absolute high of a gap-and-run with no news catalyst and elevated relative volume (3.18x) carries significant mean-reversion risk, while shorting into a stock showing persistent buying pressure and momentum through the session is equally dangerous. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable at this precise moment — the long side has no room above and the short side fights clear upward momentum — so skipping is the prudent choice.
